description: 대전광역시_자전거보관소조회서비스 [cycling networks] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 대전광역시. 대전광역시 자전거보관소조회서비스는 시내에 설치된 자전거보관소들의 위치와 수용능력에 관한 상세한 정보를 제공합니다. 해당 데이터는 자전거보관소명, 위도와 경도, 도로명주소 등 공간정보를 포함하며, 각 보관소의 보관대수 즉, 보관 가능한 자전거의 수량 정보도 함께 제공되어 이용자들이 가까운 보관소의 용량을... Coverage: 대전광역시. The portal files it under the publisher 대전광역시. Its tags are 자전거, 자전거보관소, 도로시설물, 위치좌표, 관리번호. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-07-23 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
